note: Light trigger check set: should-trigger phrasings for every check the Quality Assurance (QA) team runs (verifying work against its standard, definitions of done, test plans and runs for releases and builds, defect root cause, fact-checking claims, numbers and financial plans, red-teaming conclusions and stress-testing ideas, reviewing visuals) for a company and for the user's own documents and plans; and near-miss negatives a neighbouring department owns, phrased close to this one's. Used by the description trigger check.
should_trigger: check our investor update against the numbers before it goes out
QA this proposal before we send it to the client
verify this SOP against our definition of done before we adopt it
write the definition of done for our client reports
build a test plan for the launch of our new product catalog
run an independent test pass on the skill you just built against its requirements and tell me what breaks
triage these defects from our last batch of client deliverables
find the root cause of why our proposals keep going out with the same errors
fact-check the claims and figures in this press release before we publish it
double-check the contribution limits and tax figures in my retirement plan against the official sources before I act on it
play devil's advocate on our plan to expand into Europe
stress-test these five startup ideas and tell me which have a fatal flaw
is this chart in the board deck misleading? check it before the meeting
check this dashboard passes accessibility contrast rules before we share it
check my visa application against the requirements before I submit it
poke holes in my plan to quit my job and go freelance next spring

near_miss.query: write unit tests for the login function in my app
fix the failing checkout test in our repository
research what the evidence says about four-day work weeks
brainstorm ideas for our next product line
make a chart of our defect counts by month
build our financial model for the seed round
proofread this report for typos and tone
a customer reported a bug in the app, reply to them
should we delay the launch to fix these quality issues
is the indemnity clause in this contract enforceable
check whether our privacy policy complies with GDPR
audit our cloud accounts for security misconfigurations
set up the CI pipeline that runs our test suite
write the SOP for how our team packs orders
